Drop writes no text of a hidden element or a template

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"hidden_content\":\"Drop\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>visible</p><div role=\"tabpanel\" hidden>tab two body</div><template><p>row template</p></template>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
